fact: On 28 October 2026 Cabinet approved the Seychelles Digital & AI Strategy 2026-2031 as the national framework for digital and AI transformation through 2031, and approved an Inter-Ministerial Digital and AI Coordination Committee chaired by the minister responsible for ICT.
title: Seychelles: Cabinet Business - Wednesday 28 October, 2026
publisher: State House Seychelles (distributed by APO Group)
